title: Qualification state: distinguish executed v0.2 evidence from inherited and current-rollup evidence
summary: v0.2 was executed under ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 for the capability model, structured result model, planner, deterministic fake-libpq PostgreSQL result adapter and compile gates. Live external dependency roots were not available for that v0.2 run, so live PostgreSQL/GeoPackage evidence is inherited from v0.1 rather than re-claimed. The 2026-09-02 API roll-up contains newer Foreign Runtime v0.22.6 plus current DB Core v0.46, NoSQLServer v0.79 and msqlshim v0.21.2; those available versions are continuity references, not claims that v0.2 has been requalified against every newer companion.
invariants: Never turn retained inherited tests into newly executed evidence when dependency roots were unavailable.
Deterministic fake-provider tests qualify projection and planner logic, not a live remote database connection.
Current roll-up availability does not equal compatibility qualification.
Non-claims remain first-class evidence until the implementation and tests exist.
Qualification must name runtime and exact companion versions/digests where material.

provenance.claim: v0.2 executed provider-neutral/fake-libpq/compile gates under ooRexx r13196, retained inherited live gates, and publishes non-claims.

Current roll-up contains NoSQLServer v0.79 as a continuity reference.
